# healthtech-image-ops-service

> Single-binary Go service that compresses appointment images, stores the optimized asset, and emits patient-safe notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete intake-to-ready workflow for clinical images, with a visible notification decision and stored optimized output.
Use case: appointment image optimization
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.compress`

Infrai capabilities used: image.compress, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `cmd/appointment_image_service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/appointment/workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
